'''R-T0 twin blaster cannon''' were a type of [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]]. It was a retractable cannon that could be mounted on the aft of the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] and was designed by [[ArMek/Legends|ArMek]]. They were used in [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]].

==Behind the scenes==
The R-T0 twin blaster cannon was misspelled as R-Z0 in the display plate for the [[2010]] [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] [[LEGO Ultimate Collector's Series|''Ultimate Collector's Series'']] set [[:w:c:brickipedia:10212 Imperial Shuttle|10212 Imperial Shuttle]].
